kpmee01.title: Sent Before Thinking
kpmee01.caption:
One coffee, 0.2 seconds, one very bold text. Even Mercury had to rewind.
Aries, what's the fastest you've ever hit send?

kpmee02.title: The Three-Day Reply
kpmee02.caption:
Wanting your reply to be perfect is sweet. Three days of silence just feels like silence.
A short honest answer now beats a perfect one later. Save this for the next sweet text.

kpmee03.title: Two Chats, One Feeling
kpmee03.caption:
Gemini answered 39 chats in a minute and dodged exactly one. Guess which.
Mercury has notes, a retrograde alibi and one very slow text. Who's your one chat?

kpmee04.title: The Paragraph You Didn't Send
kpmee04.caption:
When someone goes quiet, the check-in you write can turn into nine pages of love.
Lead with the feeling and keep one ask. The rest can wait for Sunday.

kpmee05.title: Refreshing the Viewer List
kpmee05.caption:
Refresh number 43 and they finally viewed it. Mercury would like a word.
Leo, how many stories have you posted for one person?
